## Strategy

The controller uses only the per-action sensors, so it needs no coordinates or layout knowledge.

1. **Progress first.** Prefer moves that reduce the distance to the next unreached goal (`toward`). Each such move strictly lowers the Manhattan distance, so the adversary cannot make the agent circle.
2. **Filter every candidate move.** A move is acceptable only if it is not blocked by a wall, does not enter the patrol path, does not enter a goal that must not be entered yet (`early`), will not be hit by the obstacle after the move (`obstacle`), and is not exposed to a slip onto the patrol or an early goal (`risky`).
3. **Fall back to safe sideways moves** when no safe progress move exists. These are used only when the stricter rule fails, so they rarely create cycles.
4. **Wait by bumping a wall.** A move into a wall keeps the agent in place. The obstacle's phase changes every step, so waiting lets a blocking patrol pass. The move is accepted only if the obstacle will not step onto the agent's own cell.
5. **Accept small slip risk as a last resort.** Slip risk is probabilistic, and the avoidance requirement is only 0.7, so this rule allows a risky move when nothing safer is available.
6. **Catch-all.** The final rule covers any remaining state.

The sequencing requirements are handled by `early`, which forbids entering goal 2 before `g1` and goal 3 before `g2`. The `toward` sensor always targets the next unreached goal, so the same rules work for any goal placement.

The catch-all uses `any`, which is not provably safe in every state. It is included only so no state is uncovered. The earlier rules are meant to handle nearly every state, so the catch-all should rarely be reached.

```json
{"rules": [
  {"condition": "toward & !wall & !patrol & !early & !risky & !obstacle", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "!wall & !patrol & !early & !risky & !obstacle", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "wall & !patrol & !early & !obstacle", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "!patrol & !early & !obstacle", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "true", "action": "any"}
]}
```
